title: Scholarship and Group Chat
author: Lena Voss
blurb: Gideon Lockridge, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
